diagnostics.message: :resource.helm_release.karpenter: explicit depends_on of :module.karpenter is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class: explicit depends_on of :module.eks is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class: explicit depends_on of :module.karpenter is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.null_resource.update_kubeconfig: explicit depends_on of :module.eks is redundant — already implied by attribute references
null_resource.update_kubeconfig already references module.eks implicitly via module.eks.cluster_name in its local-exec provisioner; the explicit depends_on = [module.eks] duplicates that dependency.

null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class references module.eks implicitly (cluster_primary_security_group_id / cluster_security_group_id in its triggers and the templatefile local); the explicit depends_on entry for module.eks is redundant.

null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class references module.karpenter implicitly (module.karpenter.node_iam_role_arn in its triggers, node_iam_role_arn in the templatefile local, and in its depends_on); the explicit depends_on entry for module.karpenter is redundant.
null_resource.delete_daemonset already depends on null_resource.update_kubeconfig, which in turn depends on module.eks; the explicit depends_on entry for module.eks is transitively redundant.

null_resource.apply_node_pool already depends on helm_release.karpenter, which references module.eks (cluster_name/cluster_endpoint); the explicit depends_on entry for module.eks is transitively redundant.

null_resource.apply_node_pool already depends on helm_release.karpenter, which depends on null_resource.update_kubeconfig; the explicit depends_on entry for update_kubeconfig is transitively redundant.

In the Calico-on-EKS install sequence the aws-node daemonset must be deleted only after the Tigera operator and the Calico Installation resource have been applied; otherwise aws-node may be recreated by kubelet before Calico takes over networking. null_resource.delete_daemonset currently only waits on null_resource.update_kubeconfig and can run before/parallel to the Calico apply steps.
